why_it_matters.text: A medicine sold as ProAmatine and Bramox that raises low blood pressure on standing. The body converts it into desglymidodrine, which tightens blood vessels.

approval.basis: Marketed today (prescription) under ANDA 076577 in the Drugs@FDA data files.
